refnamediv.refpurpose: Restores a duration from serialized data

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.errors;
An Exception is thrown if data does not describe a valid duration, for example if an element is missing or has the wrong type, if seconds or nanoseconds are out of range, if a duration of zero is marked as negative, or if the method is called on an object that has already been initialized.
